log_evidence.caution: run.log spans refusal, LongMemEval, LoCoMo, interruptions and failures; its total is not LongMemEval wall time

memory_sample_evidence.caution: 30-second sampling aliases restart durations; spacing includes inference and is not startup latency

assumptions: Reader scales by layer visits (24+36+48+72)/48=3.75; 30s/start; stress: 60s/start and summed scaling 5; no downloads/conversions; stock quantization differs from native varloop

power.caution: Normal approximation; depth discordance unmeasured; interaction assumes independent lane difference scores with variance .42 each. Multiplicity and per-type effects need more power.
